parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel, used to control water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt around a pivot axis to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main cylindrical body of the faucet, made of stainless steel, providing structural support and housing internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the spout and switch, contains the water channels, and connects to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed base for the faucet assembly.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved outlet tube of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water from the internal channel to the sink, ensuring smooth and controlled flow.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may swivel in some designs to direct water flow.
